# NEW 2026-11-19 round 7 C7, the blockade of the City 1394-1402. Generated by gen_bayezid.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# BYZ scope, monthly. Called by the main-line scheduler (gen_mainline_lock.py, LINES, id 11, after the interregnum
# line); this line has no monthly hook of its own.
oe_byd_monthly = {
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_byd_stage } oe_byd_tick = yes }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_byd_epi }
        if = { limit = { oe_ml_free = yes } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_byd.12 }
    }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_byd_can_begin = yes oe_ml_free = yes } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_byd.1 }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_byd_west ?= 1 } oe_byd_west_tick = yes }
}

# BYZ scope. One month of the blockade: end checks, meters, tiered modifiers, at most one event.
oe_byd_tick = {
    if = { limit = { OR = { has_global_variable = oe_ivr_begun has_variable = oe_bet_round } } oe_byd_close = { code = 1 } }
    else_if = { limit = { NOT = { country_exists = c:TUR } } oe_byd_close = { code = 2 } }
    else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_osman_chain_active } oe_byd_close = { code = 5 } }
    else_if = { limit = { NOT = { owns = location:constantinople } } oe_byd_close = { code = 4 } }
    else = {
        if = { limit = { oe_byd_tur_presses = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_byd_weak_m value = 0 } }
        else = { change_variable = { name = oe_byd_weak_m add = 1 } }
        if = { limit = { AND = { has_variable = oe_byd_weak_m var:oe_byd_weak_m >= 12 } } oe_byd_close = { code = 2 } }
    }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_byd_stage } oe_byd_step = yes }
}

# BYZ scope. The month's step while the blockade runs.
oe_byd_step = {
    change_variable = { name = oe_byd_m add = 1 }
    change_variable = { name = oe_byd_food add = oe_byd_food_delta }
    clamp_variable = { name = oe_byd_food min = 0 max = 100 }
    change_variable = { name = oe_byd_morale add = oe_byd_morale_delta }
    clamp_variable = { name = oe_byd_morale min = 0 max = 100 }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_byd_morale <= 0 } change_variable = { name = oe_byd_zero_m add = 1 } }
    else = { set_variable = { name = oe_byd_zero_m value = 0 } }
    # The besieging sultan: a new one for two months opens the sultan's terms (entry 1).
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_byd_sultan } } oe_byd_save_sultan = yes }
    if = { limit = { oe_byd_sultan_ok = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_byd_sg_m value = 0 } }
    else = { change_variable = { name = oe_byd_sg_m add = 1 } }
    oe_byd_tiers = yes
    if = { limit = { oe_ml_free = yes } oe_byd_pick_event = yes }
}

# BYZ scope, lock free. At most one event: .13 when due, .11, the milestones (each with its own roll), the pool.
oe_byd_pick_event = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_byd_terms_cd } }
        remove_variable = oe_byd_terms_why
        if = { limit = { AND = { has_variable = oe_byd_zero_m var:oe_byd_zero_m >= 3 } } set_variable = { name = oe_byd_terms_why value = 3 } }
        else_if = { limit = { AND = { has_variable = oe_byd_sg_m var:oe_byd_sg_m >= 2 } NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ivr_begun } } set_variable = { name = oe_byd_terms_why value = 1 } }
        else_if = { limit = { AND = { has_variable = oe_byd_m var:oe_byd_m >= 108 } NOT = { oe_byd_timur_war = yes } } set_variable = { name = oe_byd_terms_why value = 2 } }
    }
    set_variable = { name = oe_byd_pick value = 0 }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_byd_terms_cd } has_variable = oe_byd_terms_why } set_variable = { name = oe_byd_pick value = 13 } }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_byd_ok_11 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_byd_pick value = 11 } }
    else = {
        if = { limit = { var:oe_byd_pick = 0 oe_byd_ok_2 = yes } random = { chance = 25 set_variable = { name = oe_byd_pick value = 2 } } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_byd_pick = 0 oe_byd_ok_4 = yes } random = { chance = 25 set_variable = { name = oe_byd_pick value = 4 } } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_byd_pick = 0 oe_byd_ok_5 = yes } random = { chance = 25 set_variable = { name = oe_byd_pick value = 5 } } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_byd_pick = 0 oe_byd_ok_6 = yes } random = { chance = 25 set_variable = { name = oe_byd_pick value = 6 } } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_byd_pick = 0 oe_byd_ok_10 = yes } random = { chance = 30 set_variable = { name = oe_byd_pick value = 10 } } }
    }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_byd_pick = 13 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_byd.13 }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_byd_pick = 11 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_byd.11 }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_byd_pick = 2 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_byd.2 }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_byd_pick = 4 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_byd.4 }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_byd_pick = 5 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_byd.5 }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_byd_pick = 6 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_byd.6 }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_byd_pick = 10 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_byd.10 }
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_byd_pick = 0 NOT = { has_variable = oe_byd_evcd } oe_byd_pool_any = yes }
        random = {
            chance = 25
            set_variable = { name = oe_byd_evcd months = 4 }
            random_list = {
                10 = { trigger = { oe_byd_ok_14 = yes } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_byd.14 }
                10 = { trigger = { oe_byd_ok_15 = yes } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_byd.15 }
                10 = { trigger = { oe_byd_ok_16 = yes } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_byd.16 }
                10 = { trigger = { oe_byd_ok_17 = yes } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_byd.17 }
            }
        }
    }
    remove_variable = oe_byd_pick
}

# BYZ scope. The tiered modifiers, renewed each month for 2 months (they lapse by themselves if the line stops).
oe_byd_tiers = {
    location:constantinople = { add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_byd_blockade_loc months = 2 mode = replace } }
    add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_byd_blockade months = 2 mode = replace }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_byd_food var:oe_byd_food > 0 var:oe_byd_food < 25 } location:constantinople = { add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_byd_famine months = 2 mode = replace } } }
    else = { location:constantinople = { if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_byd_famine } remove_location_modifier = oe_byd_famine } } }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_byd_food var:oe_byd_food <= 0 } location:constantinople = { add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_byd_starving months = 2 mode = replace } } }
    else = { location:constantinople = { if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_byd_starving } remove_location_modifier = oe_byd_starving } } }
    if = { limit = { AND = { has_variable = oe_byd_morale var:oe_byd_morale < 25 } } add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_byd_despair months = 2 mode = replace } }
    else = { if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_byd_despair } remove_country_modifier = oe_byd_despair } }
    if = { limit = { AND = { has_variable = oe_byd_morale var:oe_byd_morale < 25 } } location:constantinople = { add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_byd_despair_loc months = 2 mode = replace } } }
    else = { location:constantinople = { if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_byd_despair_loc } remove_location_modifier = oe_byd_despair_loc } } }
    if = { limit = { AND = { has_variable = oe_byd_morale var:oe_byd_morale >= 75 } } location:constantinople = { add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_byd_resolve months = 2 mode = replace } } }
    else = { location:constantinople = { if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_byd_resolve } remove_location_modifier = oe_byd_resolve } } }
}
oe_byd_clear_tiers = {
    location:constantinople = { if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_byd_blockade_loc } remove_location_modifier = oe_byd_blockade_loc } }
    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_byd_blockade } remove_country_modifier = oe_byd_blockade }
    location:constantinople = { if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_byd_famine } remove_location_modifier = oe_byd_famine } }
    location:constantinople = { if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_byd_starving } remove_location_modifier = oe_byd_starving } }
    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_byd_despair } remove_country_modifier = oe_byd_despair }
    location:constantinople = { if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_byd_despair_loc } remove_location_modifier = oe_byd_despair_loc } }
    location:constantinople = { if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_byd_resolve } remove_location_modifier = oe_byd_resolve } }
}

# BYZ scope. The emperor's journey (var:oe_byd_west = 1): ends quietly if that emperor no longer reigns; .9 when due.
oe_byd_west_tick = {
    change_variable = { name = oe_byd_west_m add = 1 }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { oe_byd_emp_away_ok = yes } } oe_byd_west_lost = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_byd_ok_9 = yes oe_ml_free = yes } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_byd.9 }
}
oe_byd_west_lost = {
    set_variable = oe_byd_west_lost
    remove_variable = oe_byd_west
    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_byd_emperor_abroad } remove_country_modifier = oe_byd_emperor_abroad }
}
# BYZ scope. .9: the emperor is home.
oe_byd_west_home = {
    set_variable = oe_byd_west_ret
    remove_variable = oe_byd_west
    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_byd_emperor_abroad } remove_country_modifier = oe_byd_emperor_abroad }
}
# BYZ scope. .6 a: the emperor sets out (scope:oe_byd_rg is the one left in charge).
oe_byd_go_west = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_byd_west value = 1 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_byd_west_m value = 0 }
    ruler = { save_scope_as = oe_byd_wr }
    set_variable = { name = oe_byd_west_ruler value = scope:oe_byd_wr }
    set_variable = { name = oe_byd_regent value = scope:oe_byd_rg }
    set_global_variable = oe_byd_west_begun
    add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_byd_emperor_abroad years = -1 mode = replace }
    oe_byd_relief = { food = 0 morale = 5 }
    trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_byd.7 days = 180 }
}
# BYZ scope. After .7: the emperor goes on to England if it exists; the envoys' journey is over.
oe_byd_after_paris = {
    if = { limit = { var:oe_byd_west ?= 1 country_exists = c:ENG } trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_byd.8 days = 180 } }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_byd_west ?= 2 } remove_variable = oe_byd_west set_variable = oe_byd_west_envoys }
}
# BYZ scope. .7 c, .8 b: the western reinforcements, or a little prestige while the older western aid lasts.
oe_byd_west_aid_gain = {
    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_br_western_aid } add_prestige = prestige_weak_bonus }
    else = { add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_byd_west_aid years = 10 mode = replace } }
}
# BYZ scope. .6: who would hold the capital. The heir (adult, free, ours), else the eldest adult of the dynasty at court.
oe_byd_pick_regent = {
    heir ?= {
        if = {
            limit = { is_alive = yes is_adult = yes owner ?= c:BYZ is_ruler = no NOT = { has_character_modifier = imprisoned } }
            save_scope_as = oe_byd_rg
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { exists = scope:oe_byd_rg } }
        ordered_character = { limit = { oe_ti_despot_candidate = yes } order_by = age_in_days position = 0 check_range_bounds = no save_scope_as = oe_byd_rg }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. Remembers the Ottoman ruler as the besieging sultan.
oe_byd_save_sultan = {
    c:TUR ?= { ruler ?= { save_scope_as = oe_byd_s } }
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_byd_s } set_variable = { name = oe_byd_sultan value = scope:oe_byd_s } }
}

# BYZ scope. Opens the blockade (hidden worker, or a test button).
oe_byd_open = {
    set_global_variable = oe_byd_begun
    remove_variable = oe_byd_defer
    remove_variable = oe_byd_pending
    set_variable = { name = oe_byd_stage value = 1 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_byd_m value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_byd_food value = oe_byd_food_start }
    set_variable = { name = oe_byd_morale value = oe_byd_morale_start }
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_byd_open_malus }
        change_variable = { name = oe_byd_morale add = -10 }
        clamp_variable = { name = oe_byd_morale min = 0 max = 100 }
        remove_variable = oe_byd_open_malus
    }
    set_variable = { name = oe_byd_weak_m value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_byd_zero_m value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_byd_sg_m value = 0 }
    oe_ths_yoke_annex = yes  # decision 127: Thessalonica under harac passes to direct Ottoman rule (C8 checks harac and TUR)
    oe_byd_save_sultan = yes
    oe_byd_tiers = yes
    activate_situation = situation:oe_byd_blockade
    debug_log = "oe_byd open: food [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_byd_food').GetValue|0] morale [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_byd_morale').GetValue|0]"
}
# BYZ scope. Closes the blockade with an end code (1 to the interregnum, 2 broke up, 3 terms, 4 city lost, 5 void).
# 1-3 leave the epilogue (.12) for the next free month; 4 and 5 end the line at once, silently.
oe_byd_close = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_byd_stage }
        remove_variable = oe_byd_stage
        set_variable = { name = oe_byd_end_c value = $code$ }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_byd_end value = $code$ }
        set_variable = { name = oe_byd_closed_at value = oe_ml_month_now }
        remove_variable = oe_byd_terms_why
        oe_byd_clear_tiers = yes
        if = { limit = { var:oe_byd_end_c <= 3 } set_variable = oe_byd_epi }
        else = { set_global_variable = oe_byd_done }
        debug_log = "oe_byd close: end [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_byd_end_c').GetValue|0] after [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_byd_m').GetValue|0] months"
    }
}
# BYZ scope. .12, on entry: the settlement by city morale, then the line is over.
oe_byd_epilogue = {
    remove_variable = oe_byd_epi
    set_global_variable = oe_byd_done
    if = { limit = { AND = { has_variable = oe_byd_morale var:oe_byd_morale >= 60 } } oe_byd_auth = { amount = 5 } oe_byd_opin = { amount = 5 } }
    else_if = { limit = { AND = { has_variable = oe_byd_morale var:oe_byd_morale >= 30 } } oe_byd_auth = { amount = 2 } }
    else = { oe_byd_auth = { amount = -3 } oe_byd_opin = { amount = -5 } }
    if = {
        limit = { OR = { var:oe_byd_end_c ?= 1 var:oe_byd_end_c ?= 2 } }
        add_prestige = prestige_mild_bonus
        remove_variable = oe_byd_quarter
    }
}

# BYZ scope. The hidden worker oe_byd.90: the heavy jobs of the options (var:oe_byd_do: 1 refuse the summons and open
# the blockade, 3 accept the sultan's terms, 4 answer the summons and pay, 5 play for time). Closing needs no worker of
# its own: the monthly tick closes the blockade, and .13 a closes it through 3.
oe_byd_do_job = {
    if = { limit = { var:oe_byd_do ?= 1 } oe_byd_refuse_summons = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_byd_do ?= 3 } oe_byd_accept_terms = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_byd_do ?= 4 } oe_byd_attend = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_byd_do ?= 5 } oe_byd_stall = yes }
    remove_variable = oe_byd_do
}
# BYZ scope. .1 a: answer no more summonses. Any agreement with the Ottomans lapses without penalty; the blockade opens.
oe_byd_refuse_summons = {
    c:TUR ?= { if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_ttb_peace } oe_ttb_peace_clear = yes } }
    oe_ttb_recount = yes
    oe_byd_auth = { amount = 3 }
    oe_byd_open = yes
}
# BYZ scope. .1 b/c: go, and pay. The tribute, a second time costs authority and opinion, no summons for 3 years.
oe_byd_attend = {
    remove_variable = oe_byd_pending
    oe_byd_tribute = yes
    if = { limit = { AND = { has_variable = oe_byd_defers var:oe_byd_defers >= 1 } } oe_byd_auth = { amount = -5 } oe_byd_opin = { amount = -5 } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_byd_defers } } set_variable = { name = oe_byd_defers value = 0 } }
    change_variable = { name = oe_byd_defers add = 1 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_byd_defer years = 3 }
}
# BYZ scope. .1 d: envoys play for time. Half the time the sultan waits a year; else the blockade opens, morale -10.
oe_byd_stall = {
    remove_variable = oe_byd_pending
    oe_byd_pay = { months = 1 }
    random_list = {
        50 = { set_variable = { name = oe_byd_defer months = 12 } }
        50 = { set_variable = oe_byd_open_malus oe_byd_open = yes }
    }
}
# BYZ scope. Tribute to the sultan: a new 5-year buying-peace agreement (the tribute track's own effect), or, with one
# running, six months of trade and tax income at once and another 5 years.
oe_byd_tribute = {
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:TUR c:TUR = { has_variable = oe_ttb_peace } }
        save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = oe_byd_amt value = oe_byd_six_months }
        add_gold = { value = scope:oe_byd_amt multiply = -1 }
        c:TUR = {
            add_gold = scope:oe_byd_amt
            set_variable = { name = oe_ttb_peace value = var:oe_ttb_peace years = 5 }
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:TUR }
        c:TUR = { save_scope_as = oe_ttb_t }
        oe_ttb_peace_sign = yes
    }
}
# BYZ scope. .13 a: accept the sultan's terms: tribute, perhaps a quarter, the blockade ends (3).
oe_byd_accept_terms = {
    oe_byd_tribute = yes
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_byd_terms_q } oe_byd_grant_quarter = yes remove_variable = oe_byd_terms_q }
    oe_byd_close = { code = 3 }
}
# BYZ scope. .13 b: refuse (not the collapse entry): morale +5; a new sultan becomes the besieger.
oe_byd_refuse_terms = {
    oe_byd_relief = { food = 0 morale = 5 }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_byd_terms_why ?= 1 } oe_byd_save_sultan = yes set_variable = { name = oe_byd_sg_m value = 0 } }
    remove_variable = oe_byd_terms_why
}
# BYZ scope. A Turkish quarter in the city (.4 b, .13 a at the collapse).
oe_byd_grant_quarter = {
    set_variable = oe_byd_quarter
    c:TUR ?= { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_byd_quarter_op target = c:BYZ } }
}

# BYZ scope. .3 on entry: the battle is rolled; the result is kept here and globally (1 defeat, 2 victory).
oe_byd_nicopolis_roll = {
    random = { chance = oe_byd_nico_chance set_variable = { name = oe_byd_nicopolis value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_byd_nicopolis } } set_variable = { name = oe_byd_nicopolis value = 1 } }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_byd_nicopolis value = var:oe_byd_nicopolis }
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_byd_nicopolis = 2 }
        oe_byd_relief = { food = 10 morale = 15 }
        c:TUR ?= { add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_byd_nicopolis_tur years = 5 mode = replace } }
    }
    else = {
        oe_byd_relief = { food = 0 morale = -10 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_byd_crusade ?= 2 } set_variable = { name = oe_byd_wrath months = 18 } }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_byd_crusade ?= 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_byd_wrath months = 9 } }
    }
}
# BYZ scope. .3 b: the sultan's wrath lasts half as long.
oe_byd_halve_wrath = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_byd_wrath }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_byd_crusade ?= 2 } set_variable = { name = oe_byd_wrath months = 9 } }
        else = { set_variable = { name = oe_byd_wrath months = 5 } }
    }
}
# BYZ scope. .5 a: a sally with the French (grain +15; morale +10, or -5 in one case of four).
oe_byd_sally = {
    random_list = {
        75 = { oe_byd_relief = { food = 15 morale = 10 } }
        25 = { oe_byd_relief = { food = 15 morale = -5 } }
    }
}
# BYZ scope. .14 a: open the granaries.
oe_byd_open_granary = {
    change_variable = { name = oe_byd_food add = oe_byd_granary_relief }
    clamp_variable = { name = oe_byd_food min = 0 max = 100 }
    oe_byd_relief = { food = 0 morale = 5 }
}
# BYZ scope. .17: the assault; gen = yes when the Genoese help. Records the result for the situation's text.
oe_byd_assault = {
    if = { limit = { always = $gen$ } random = { chance = oe_byd_hold_chance_gen set_variable = oe_byd_held } }
    else = { random = { chance = oe_byd_hold_chance set_variable = oe_byd_held } }
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_byd_held }
        oe_byd_relief = { food = 0 morale = 10 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_byd_last_assault value = 1 }
        remove_variable = oe_byd_held
    }
    else = {
        oe_byd_relief = { food = -5 morale = -10 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_byd_last_assault value = 2 }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. Grain stores and city morale change by $food$ and $morale$, kept within 0-100; nothing when no blockade runs.
# Interface for other lines (D2's Russian alms: oe_byd_relief = { food = 0 morale = 5 }).
oe_byd_relief = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_byd_stage }
        change_variable = { name = oe_byd_food add = $food$ }
        clamp_variable = { name = oe_byd_food min = 0 max = 100 }
        change_variable = { name = oe_byd_morale add = $morale$ }
        clamp_variable = { name = oe_byd_morale min = 0 max = 100 }
    }
}
# Any scope. Imperial Authority / public opinion of the Imperial Pillars change by $amount$, kept within 0-100.
oe_byd_auth = { international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars ?= { if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_pillars_authority } change_variable = { name = oe_pillars_authority add = $amount$ } clamp_variable = { name = oe_pillars_authority min = 0 max = 100 } } } }
oe_byd_opin = { international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars ?= { if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_pillars_public_opinion } change_variable = { name = oe_pillars_public_opinion add = $amount$ } clamp_variable = { name = oe_pillars_public_opinion min = 0 max = 100 } } } }
# BYZ scope. Pay / gain $months$ months of trade and tax income.
oe_byd_pay = { add_gold = { value = monthly_income_trade_and_tax multiply = -$months$ } }
oe_byd_gain = { add_gold = { value = monthly_income_trade_and_tax multiply = $months$ } }

# BYZ scope. Test button: the summons now, without the start conditions.
oe_byd_test_summon = {
    oe_byd_save_sultan = yes
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_byd.1
}
